zh.title: 羅馬尼亞接收首批兩架升級 IAR-99 教練機 支援 F-16 飛行員訓練
zh.summary: 羅馬尼亞接收首批兩架 IAR-99 SM 教練機，10 架升級案交付較原定時程延後逾兩年。
body: 羅馬尼亞國防部已接收首批兩架 IAR-99 SM 升級教練機，11月16日在克拉約瓦完成交付。國營製造商 Avioane Craiova 承攬的10架升級案，首批交付較原定期限延後逾兩年。
這批飛機將由博博克的空軍應用學校操作，支援飛行員轉換至 F-16 的進階訓練，並保留次要近接空中支援能力。升級內容包括航電、武器系統及延長機體壽命的維修工作。
2020年簽署的合約原定於2024年完成。據羅馬尼亞通訊社報導，第三架可望於11月底前交付，仍須視試飛天候而定；其餘七架目前預計於2027年底前交付。

en.title: Romania receives first two upgraded IAR-99 SM trainers for F-16 pilot training
en.summary: Romania has accepted the first two IAR-99 SM trainers, more than two years after the original delivery deadline.
body: Romania has accepted the first two of ten IAR-99 SM trainers upgraded by state-owned Avioane Craiova. The aircraft were handed over in Craiova on November 16, more than two years after the original delivery deadline.

They will serve at the Air Force Application School in Boboc, supporting advanced training for pilots transitioning to the F-16 while retaining a secondary close air support role. The upgrade includes avionics, weapons systems and maintenance to extend airframe life.

The contract was signed in 2020 and originally due for completion in 2024. AGERPRES reported that a third aircraft could arrive by late November, weather permitting for test flights. The remaining seven are currently expected by the end of 2027.

facts.claim: Romania accepted the first two of ten modernized IAR-99 SM trainers in Craiova on November 16, 2026.
The trainers will support the transition to F-16 flying at the Air Force Application School in Boboc.
A third delivery depends on test-flight weather; the remaining seven are expected by December 31, 2027.
